profiles.domain: one exact request, one complete immutable parent bundle, and one exact resolved FLT-owned plan
restrictions: exactly one supported MAP-observation, MAP-coadd, or JINC-observation parent role
complete applicable parent and boundary identity
exceptions: base signal may carry typed unavailable response or covariance state
qualified requests require their named available compatible companion
profiles.consumer_action: admit the exact bundle to row admission, or fail closed with typed causes; perform no payload arithmetic

profiles.domain: one candidate output row under one eligible bundle, frozen plan, immutable parent domain, and exact K_req
restrictions: every K_req location lies in the exact parent domain
every K_req location is admitted for this FLT use
every K_req value is available and finite
J_full is frozen before payload arithmetic
exceptions: identity uses K_req equal to the singleton zero offset
zero uses its declared inherited admitted parent-support row domain and never a vacuous empty-footprint domain
profiles.consumer_action: construct the one immutable J_full or return typed row and decision causes; perform no payload arithmetic

profiles.domain: one eligible complete SCI-FLT-FIXED publication candidate after application
restrictions: complete candidate contains every required FLT role
base signal contains exact response and covariance state records, which may be unavailable
response-qualified candidate has an available exact compatible response
covariance-qualified candidate has the exact declared compatible covariance representation
jointly qualified candidate satisfies both companion qualifications
NOI attachment state is a relation record and an NOI product is not required
exceptions: optional companion unavailability does not block a base signal request
identity and zero use the same complete-candidate and publication sequence
profiles.consumer_action: publish exactly one immutable realized FLT product after successful action, or publish no product and preserve typed causes
